stories.title: Nvidia employees greet Jensen Huang like a hero as he returns to company’s HQ
stories.take: Huang got a hero's welcome back at HQ and promised to be 'a better CEO the second time around' — the reinstatement story is now a full-blown saga.

stories.title: Jensen Huang scheduled to testify next week in Senate following reinstatement as Nvidia CEO
stories.take: Next step in the saga: Huang testifies before the Senate next week, with bipartisan calls to explain the affair allegations and Trump's role in his return.

stories.title: Google Search’s AI Mode can now tap into Drive and Wallet for more personalized responses
stories.take: Google's AI Mode gets Personal Intelligence hooks into Drive and Wallet — more useful answers, bought with deeper access to your own data.

stories.title: Amazon snaps up Decart’s AI optimization tech for $7.5B as it prepares to sell Trainium chips
stories.take: Amazon pays a reported $7.5B for Decart's AI optimization tech and team as it gears up to sell Trainium chips to outside customers.

stories.title: Surveillance pricing uses our personal data to make us pay more
stories.take: Personalized pricing is quietly turning your data into a reason to charge you more — and it can bake in bias, too.

stories.title: Meta throws out its net-zero goal — its competitors should be furious
stories.take: Meta walks back its 2030 net-zero pledge in its 2026 sustainability report — a retreat rivals that kept their targets will not let it forget.

stories.title: Every 3D artist should have an AI assistant, Maxon says as it launches new tools and agentic licences
stories.take: Maxon brings AI generation to Cinema 4D and ZBrush with agentic licences — and, notably, an off switch for artists who want one.

stories.title: Agencies are selling AI efficiency — clients want outcomes
stories.take: Agencies pitched AI as cheaper and faster for two years; clients have stopped nodding and started asking what it actually delivered.

stories.title: Modelo Becomes First Official Beer of the NCAA
stories.take: Modelo lands the NCAA's first official beer sponsorship — March Madness is the headline, but the deal covers 90-plus championships.

stories.title: Carl’s Jr. taps David&Goliath as marketing focus turns to boldness
stories.take: Carl's Jr. hands its account to David&Goliath and goes cooked-to-order system-wide — a bet that bold marketing needs a product change behind it.

stories.title: How GTA 6’s interface kept the classic Pricedown font but still managed to feel modern
stories.take: Rockstar's UI team kept GTA's classic Pricedown type but rebuilt the HUD around a phone in hand and accessibility from the start.

stories.title: Dr. Alex Cooper Prescribes Less Screen Time in Google Pixel’s Holiday Ad
stories.take: Google Pixel's holiday ad casts Alex Cooper as a 'Phonehead Therapy' prescriber of less screen time — a phone brand selling you time away from phones.

stories.title: Ranking NBA's biggest winners and losers of the week: Knicks hit their stride, while Celtics take step back
stories.take: Week in review: the Knicks have hit their stride, the Celtics have taken a step back, and parity is the league's defining feature right now.

stories.title: Golliver's too-early NBA All-Star picks: The 24 most deserving players right now
stories.take: Three months early is exactly when All-Star arguments are most fun — Golliver locks in the 24 most deserving names so far, Wemby and Giannis included.

stories.title: 2027 NBA Draft Big Board: Quentin Coleman's meteoric rise, Tyran Stokes stays at No. 1, returners boost stock
stories.take: Three weeks into the college season, Quentin Coleman is the draft board's meteoric riser — Tyran Stokes still holds No. 1.

stories.title: How a season without their 'admiral' showed the Rockets what they were missing
stories.take: A healthy Fred VanVleet is commanding the surging Rockets — last season's ACL absence taught Houston exactly what he brings.

stories.title: Sources: Kings set to boost backcourt depth with Vincent signing
stories.take: The Kings are finalizing a deal with Gabe Vincent for their 15th roster spot, per Shams — cheap, playoff-tested backcourt depth.

stories.title: MLB CBA negotiations timeline: League, MLBPA trade new proposals over revenue sharing as Dec. 1 deadline nears
stories.take: The Dec. 1 deadline is a week out: league and union have traded new revenue-sharing proposals, and a work stoppage still looms over the winter.

stories.title: MLB rumors: Mets' Tarik Skubal follow-up, where Blue Jays turn now, plus Yankees, Phillies, Red Sox, more
stories.take: Hot stove follow-through: what the Mets do after the Skubal blockbuster, where the spurned Blue Jays turn next, and the Yankees, Phillies and Red Sox latest.

stories.title: Sources: Yankees continue to strengthen bullpen, sign Suter to 1-year, $4M deal
stories.take: The Yankees keep stacking the bullpen — lefty Brent Suter signs for one year and $4M with a club option for 2028.

stories.title: Sources: Tigers stay busy, add '24 AL Rookie of Year Gil to pitching mix
stories.take: Detroit picks up Luis Gil, the 2024 AL Rookie of the Year, on a one-year $2.3M deal days after the Yankees non-tendered him.

stories.title: Mets, CF Ewing agree on 8-year, $95M extension, sources say
stories.take: The Mets' spending day wasn't just Skubal: 22-year-old center fielder A.J. Ewing locks in an eight-year, $95M extension.

stories.title: Brewers receive full playoff share of $493,044; total pool down from 2025
stories.take: A full World Series share for the champion Brewers pays $493,044 — and the total players' pool, about $114.5M, is down from the last two seasons.

stories.title: Top Democrats raise corruption concerns after Trump involvement in Jensen Huang’s Nvidia reinstatement – live
stories.take: Top Democrats are raising corruption concerns over Trump's hand in Huang's Nvidia reinstatement — the tech story is now a Washington story.

stories.title: Trump defers to appeals court over army plan to detonate bomb-making material in Iowa
stories.take: Trump says the Army won't detonate 68 barrels of degraded bomb-making material in Iowa without court approval, after environmentalists sued over lead pollution.

stories.title: Senate leadership vote tests newly elected Democrats' promise of change
stories.take: Incoming Democratic senators face an early test of their change-the-Senate promises: picking the leader of their new majority.

stories.title: Airline glitches and storms could make Thanksgiving travel messy
stories.take: A week of airline technical glitches plus incoming storms points to a messy Thanksgiving travel rush — build in buffer if you're flying.

stories.title: Child safety groups urge Amazon and eBay to stop selling AI toys until proved safe
stories.take: More than 150 child-safety groups across six continents want Amazon and eBay to pull AI toys until they're proved safe for kids.

stories.title: Amtrak train derails after colliding with tractor-trailer in Louisiana
stories.take: An Amtrak train hit a tractor-trailer at a Louisiana crossing and derailed; five passengers were hurt, none with life-threatening injuries.

stories.title: Failure of Cop31 prompts calls for urgent reform of UN climate summits
stories.take: After COP31 collapsed without a deal, Al Gore and other climate leaders are demanding reform of the UN summit consensus rule itself.

stories.title: L.A. Rep. Jimmy Gomez quitting after ethics panel finds evidence of sexual misconduct
stories.take: L.A. Rep. Jimmy Gomez is quitting after the House ethics panel found substantial evidence of unwanted sexual advances toward a staffer — he disputes the findings.

stories.title: California, other states sue HUD over policy to check immigrant status of public housing residents
stories.take: California and other states sue HUD over a mid-December rule forcing everyone in federally funded housing to prove citizenship or legal status.

stories.title: California coast faces historic flooding threat this week: Here's what you need to know
stories.take: King tides plus El Niño could bring historic coastal flooding from the Bay Area to San Diego during Thanksgiving week — here's the county-by-county picture.

stories.title: Nine people shot at central California concert with one in critical condition
stories.take: Nine people were shot at a concert in Strathmore in Tulare County on Saturday night, one critically; authorities say it may be gang-related.

stories.title: Beverly Hills landscaper dies in massive crane collapse
stories.take: A landscaper working for a city contractor was killed when a crane collapsed in Beverly Hills.

stories.title: ‘It’s an embarrassment’: how LA’s desperately needed airport tram went off the rails
stories.take: LAX's SkyLink people mover: under 2.5 miles, $1B over budget and four years late — a case study in how LA builds transit.

stories.title: At Trump's behest, NVIDIA's CEO gets his job back
stories.take: Trump lobbied Nvidia's board directly and took credit for Huang's reinstatement, dismissing the spy concerns • Hosts say the real security issue is the chip loophole: $60B in advanced Nvidia chips flowed to Malaysia, Singapore and Thailand over 18 months, with Chinese firms using those data centers • Conflicts flagged: Trump's own Nvidia investments and Nvidia's donation to his White House ballroom project • Bipartisan scrutiny is building — even Newt Gingrich wants Congress to dig in, and Commerce Secretary Lutnick faces the Senate Banking Committee

stories.title: Nvidia Rehires Huang in Stunning Comeback Following Trump Push
stories.take: Analysts call the week a real-time lesson in key-person risk — a succession plan and better governance are now top of the agenda • Credit analyst Rob Schiffman: the return eases financing fears, but AI debt is heading to $400–500B+ in 2027 on increasingly creative structured deals • Trump's backing may shield Nvidia from DOJ, Commerce and SEC exposure for now, but a 5-year statute of limitations leaves a future administration room to revisit • Yale's Gautam Mukunda called it unprecedented state capitalism and said the board should resign

stories.title: Too Big to Fire: Jensen Huang Is Back as Nvidia CEO
stories.take: Huang returns 11 days after resigning, following an organized campaign — StandWithJensen.com drew 10,000+ employees and 108,000 shareholders • Markets exploded: Nvidia up nearly 35%, roughly $1T added pre-market, and Nasdaq 100 futures briefly halted on a 7% upside jump • The frame: 'too big to fire' — Nvidia as the AI economy's central bank made state intervention feel inevitable • Critics warn about presidents picking CEOs, with major congressional hearings predicted for 2027

stories.title: The Shocking Return of Jensen Huang
stories.take: Trump joined Sunday's board meeting and gave national-security assurances; the stock reversed violently — Nvidia up 32%, nearly $1T in market cap • Kantrowitz frames it as a governance and culture failure: no succession plan, handshake deals, circular 'Bank of Jensen' financing • SEC, FBI, DOJ and congressional investigations are still pending • Likely outcome: a reshuffled board and tougher export controls that close China's Southeast Asia chip-rental loophole

stories.title: Drowning in credit card debt
stories.take: US credit card debt sits near $1.3T at average rates over 20% • The Sanders-Hawley bill would cap rates at 10% and once had Trump's support — but passage in its current form looks unlikely, and banks warn they would cut credit lines and rewards • The burden falls hardest on the bottom 20–30% of borrowers, even though balances concentrate in middle and upper-middle incomes • Historian Elizabeth Cohen traces today's affordability politics to the post-WWII consumer-economy circle breaking down in the 1970s

stories.title: GTA 6 is Officially The Biggest Launch in History - Kinda Funny Games Daily 11.23.26
stories.take: The answer: $3.79B in pre-orders plus first-day sales in 24 hours on 32.5M presale units — outgrossing Avengers: Endgame's $2.9B in a single day • Hosts credit the detail and discoverability (mini-golf, physics clips) and a Lucia-led story reaching beyond hardcore gamers; GTA Online guessed at 1–2 years away • Patch 1.002.002 (~603MB) fixes the broken auto-save • Deborah Ann Woll returns as Faye in Amazon's God of War series
